D

The initial electrostatic force F is proportional to the product of the charges, q1*q2 = 3*9 = 27. When the identical conducting spheres are brought into contact, the total charge of 12 mC is shared equally, resulting in 6 mC on each sphere. The new force is proportional to the new product of charges, 6*6 = 36. Therefore, the new force is (36/27)F.

question.html:
Two identical conducting spheres have charges 3 mC and 9 mC. The force between the spheres is F.

The spheres are put into contact and then returned to their initial positions. What is the new magnitude of the force between the spheres?
